You see anniversary remains.

Location

Spawns at the spot where Chayenne, Count Tofifti, Craban, Denson Larika, Grimrat, Lionet, Lyxoph, Penciljack and Skyrr get killed during the celebration of Tibia's 15th Anniversary.

Notes


* For Chayenne: Every player can use it once and will get two Surprise Bag (Red), an Anniversary Cake, 15 Platinum Coins, and either a Giant Shimmering Pearl or Chayenne's Magical Key (very rare). Upon using the cake you will be teleported to Ab'Dendriel temple.

  • For Count Tofifti: Every player can use it once and will get three Surprise Bags (Red), an Anniversary Cake and 15 Platinum Coins. Upon using the cake you will be teleported to Grizzly Adams.
  • For Craban: Every player can use it once and will get 30 Sudden Death Runes, a Silver Rune Emblem (Sudden Death), 2 Spooky Blue Eyes, Sample of Venorean Spice and a Surprise Bag (Red). Upon using the cake you will be teleported to Edron castle.
  • For Denson Larika: Every player can use it once and will get: a Giant Shimmering Pearl, 5 Small Emeralds, Golden Rune Emblem (Chameleon), 5 Green Piece of Cloth, and Sniper Gloves. Upon using the cake you will be teleported downstairs.
  • For Grimrat: Every player can use it once and will get 5 Surprise Bags (Red). Upon using the cake you will be teleported to outside of Orc Fortress near of its entrance.
  • For Lionet: Every player can use it once and will get: two Surprise Bag (Red), 3 Ectoplasmic Sushi, 10 Platinum Coins, a Broken Ring of Ending, and rarely a Seashell Book (Green). Upon using the cake you will be teleported to Fiehonja, south of the statue of Qjell (here (33447, 31308, 14)).
  • For Lyxoph: Every player can use it once and will get: an Easel, an Artist's Canvas, an Artist's Brush, an Artist's Palette and a Surprise Bag (Red). Upon using the cake you will be teleported close to the eastern tower of Rottin Wood and the married men settlement.
  • For Penciljack: Every player can use it once and will get an Easel, an Artist's Canvas, an Artist's Brush, an Artist's Palette and a Surprise Bag (Red). Upon using the cake you will be teleported to Vengoth's ship captain Harlow.
  • For Skyrr: Every player can use it once and will get 5 Surprise Bags (Red). Upon using the cake you will be teleported down the ramp on the east side of the mountain, here (32184, 31231, 7).
